item.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who reprimanded group near tomb
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth awarded a medal to the service member who reprimanded his group for making noise at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier​.

item.title: Trump says Vance should focus solely on domestic corruption
item.description: President Trump posted on social media Thursday that he asked Vice President JD Vance to "focus his complete and total attention" on domestic corruption. Washington Sun senior editor Dave Levinthal and Semafor congressional reporter Nicholas Wu join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: D.C. gunman appeared to vent about problems with luxury condo
item.description: An X account associated with D.C. shooting suspect Matt Lambert was filled with complaints about mold, rodents and disrepair in his unit in the condo building.

item.title: 1 killed, 4 injured in shooting in D.C.; suspect is dead
item.description: The suspect, identified as a 55-year-old doctor, was found dead in his apartment from a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said.

item.title: Drunken raccoon merch raises money for local animals that need help
item.description: Last year, a raccoon broke into a Virginia liquor store and sampled lots of spirits before passing out next to the toilet. The internet was delighted, and a local shelter turned that moment into merch, raising money for other animals in the area.

item.title: The role of new right populism in the GOP's future
item.description: Oren Cass, founder and chief economist at the conservative think tank American Compass, joins "The Takeout" to discuss the future of populism in the Republican Party.

item.title: Storm front to bring possible hail, tornadoes to Northeast
item.description: A big storm that was hitting the Northeast on Thursday could bring tornadoes, hail and heavy rain to the region, which could then see a steep drop in temperature, with many areas forecast to dip well below freezing. Rob Marciano has more.

item.title: Pope Leo calls on followers to "value women" and "respect girls"
item.description: Pope Leo visited Peru on Thursday, where he said he learned "what it means to be a shepherd" when he had lived and served in the country for several decades. He gave an emotional speech in which he denounced the culture of "machismo" and called on followers to "value women." Chris Livesay has more.

item.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who reprimanded his group at Arlington National Cemetery
item.description: The soldier who loudly and publicly reprimanded Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and his guests at Arlington National Cemetery was summoned to the Pentagon on Thursday. Charlie D'Agata reports on what happened next.

item.title: Cruise ship detained by Coast Guard in Miami cleared to sail
item.description: The MSC Poesia was detained in Miami earlier this month after the Coast Guard "identified deficiencies with systems on board the vessel."

item.title: Rep. Nikki Budzinski on how she wants Democrats to work for voters in new Congress
item.description: Illinois Rep. Nikki Budzinski, newly-elected chair of the New Democrat Coalition, joins "The Takeout" to discuss her party's plans as Democrats take control of Congress.

item.title: Suspected D.C. gunman who killed 1, wounded 4 identified as a doctor, police say
item.description: A gunman killed one person and wounded four others when he opened fire in a gym in Washington, D.C., and then later from his penthouse balcony, police said. The suspected shooter, a 55-year-old doctor, then took his own life, authorities said. Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Video shows moment of Brooklyn building's collapse that killed at least 8
item.description: The massive search and rescue effort in the rubble of a collapsed three-story building in Brooklyn ended on Thursday. At least eight people died, including two children. Lilia Luciano has the latest.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett on Scott Colom's Senate win: "Mississippi has been overlooked"
item.description: Rep. Jasmine Crockett joins "The Takeout" to share her thoughts on Democrat Scott Colom's upset win in the Mississippi Senate race.

item.title: Mississippi reacts after Scott Colom wins Senate race
item.description: CBS news projects that Scott Colom has won the Mississippi Senate race after a razor tight battle with Cindy Hyde-Smith. CBS News' Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: Trump calls for former Apple leader Tim Cook to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Reactions are coming in from the White House and beyond after Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of the company on Thursday following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. President Trump suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a replacement. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent and Weijia Jiang have more.

item.title: What happens next as Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO following affair scandal
item.description: Jensen Huang resigned from his position as Nvidia CEO on Thursday following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded the company in 1993. CBS News' Major Garrett shares his thoughts and Jo Ling Kent reports.

item.title: Ex-Oklahoma death row inmate pleads guilty to lesser charge
item.description: During his time on death row, courts set nine different execution dates for Richard Glossip, and he came so close to being put to death that he ate three separate last meals.

item.title: Critics say Lutnick failed to cut off diversion of Nvidia chips to China
item.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is under fire by critics asking whether his ties to Chinese companies friendship with ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang contributed to a lack of oversight over Nvidia AI chip sales.

item.title: What to know after Hegseth awards medal to soldier who reprimanded group at Arlington
item.description: Shanelle Kaul breaks down the timeline of events after a service member reprimanded Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's group for making noise at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day. Hegseth on Thursday awarded the service member, Spc. Thomas Iglesias, with a medal.

item.title: White House warns of "blatant criminality" in Democratic probes
item.description: White House counsel Will Scharf warned that congressional subpoenas could lead to investigations from the executive branch.

item.title: USPS adds permanent postage surcharge, citing higher fuel costs
item.description: Still swimming in red ink, the USPS said it will raise some postage prices in 2027 to offset elevated fuel costs.

item.title: What Jensen Huang's resignation means for Nvidia, global AI race
item.description: Ben Buchanan, who served as special adviser on AI in the Biden administration, joins "The Takeout" to discuss the ramifications of Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia.

item.title: What we know about Jensen Huang's resignation so far
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation is effective immediately, less than a week after he admitted to having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. CBS News Bay Area's Drew Andre reports, and Paul R. La Monica, Barron's senior markets analysis writer, has more.

item.title: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress appointed as Interim CEO as Huang resigns
item.description: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress was appointed Interim CEO on Thursday after previous leader Jensen Huang resigned in the wake of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: The Jensen Huang Scandal & How to Spot a Honey Trap | Straight up with Kelly and Vlad
item.description: A billionaire, affairs, and an alleged honey trap at the hands of the Chinese government. This week, Vlad and Kelly are going inside the world of honey traps, Romeos, and sexpionage. With former intelligence officer and historian, Mark Jacobson, and investigative journalist and author of "The Game," Neil Strauss, they unpack how spies exploit attraction, ego, and emotions to get close to the world's most powerful people—and why sometimes the most dangerous secrets are spilled in pillow talk.

item.title: What men should know about new prostate cancer screening guidelines
item.description: The American Cancer Society is recommending routine prostate cancer screening for more middle-aged men, in a major change to its guidelines.

item.title: Major AI developers can't control their own tech, lawsuit alleges
item.description: Companies including Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI are knowingly building technology that poses catastrophic risks to humanity, nonprofit groups claim in a lawsuit.

item.title: Man accused of burying baby tried to flee state, authorities say
item.description: A South Carolina man accused of burying his 11-month-old son in a dog crate in a clump of scrubby pines was denied bond Thursday.

item.title: Frankie Muniz released from hospital after crashing race car
item.description: Actor and race car driver Frankie Muniz has been released from a Florida hospital after a crash during a practice lap at Daytona International Speedway.
